# Muscle_Forces

[Project home](../../../README.md) · [Folder guide](../../../Documentation/project_structure.md)

Muscle_Forces

Computed intact-cat forward results. The columns and named arrays below describe the simulated quantities. [Simulation results](../simulation_report.md).

- [passive_fiber_tendon_component_N.csv](passive_fiber_tendon_component_N.csv) — Passive fiber contribution projected along the tendon, in newtons. It is already included in total tension and must not be added to tendon_tension_N again.
- [tendon_tension_N.csv](tendon_tension_N.csv) — Muscle–tendon tensile force in newtons, obtained from elastic tendon and fiber equilibrium.
